author: Quaternius

licenseEvidence.note: No license document inside the downloaded mirror ZIP or GLB metadata. CC0 verified on the official pack page and all selected mirror model records; canonical CC0 text preserved locally.

limitations: Official Drive downloads returned quota-exceeded HTML and were not used as assets.
The authorized mirror supplies three distinct human models, not the four listed in the official Drive folder.
The mirror GLBs were converted from FBX using FBX2glTF v0.9.7; no byte-for-byte equivalence with inaccessible official glTF is claimed.
Cube Woman has 36 clips including .001 duplicates; use the 18 base names unless intentional.
Rest bounds and semantic palette were inspected statically; actual runtime rendering/animation is validated by the parent app.

customization.coordinateConvention: Pixel origin top-left; x=floor(u*width), y=floor(v*height); GLTF textures use flipY=false.
customization.method: Clone material and texture per avatar; replace sourceRGB palette colors for each role. Do not globally tint the material for clothing-only changes. Preserve nearest filtering for the palette.
customization.sourceIntegrity: Original GLBs unchanged; atlas.png is an exact extraction of the embedded source PNG.

models.name: Cube Guy Character
models.author: Quaternius

restMeshBounds.measurement: Mesh positions transformed by node hierarchy; not an animated/skinned pose bound.

headSocket.note: Attach accessories to Head. Its inherited scale is approximately 100; compensate size in bone-local space or follow world position/quaternion from a root-level socket. Verify all clips visually.

models.frontAxisEvidence: Eye-colored vertices lie on negative mesh-local Y; the Character node rotates -90 degrees on X, placing eyes on world +Z.

accessoryFit.offsetSpace: World axes in initial bind pose, relative to Head world origin; intended for a global socket with initial Head quaternion removed.
accessoryFit.measurement: Original GLB positions skinned by joint world matrices and inverse bind matrices, then normalized to 1.72 high. Eye vertices isolated by source atlas RGB and dominant Head skin weight; eyeSpacing measures left/right eye centers.

headbandProfileAtZ.selection: Midpoint of skin head depth in bind-space world axes; source geometry, no added clearance.

capEnvelope.note: Full hair has no separate node/material. A fitted cap can cover the upper hair envelope with its rim below hair maxY. Closer-to-scalp fit requires hiding/clipping relevant hair triangles or accommodating their measured contour.

geometry.coordinateSpace: Head-relative offsets along world axes of initial pose, after exact skinning and height normalization. No extra .4 offset and no visual clearance.
geometry.measurement: Triangle-plane intersections, not only bins of source vertices. headBounds includes hair. Section extrema are outer envelope and may include disconnected locks.

earcupWindow.measurement: Exact triangle-polygon clipping to the earcup footprint specified by the accessory implementer: eyeY+.035, height .23, depth .225, centered on headband Z. No clearance or earcup thickness added.

headbandRiseWindow.measurement: Head surface above earY-.04 within the same depth slab; use as a conservative band-side envelope, no added clearance.
